main_text.p: corum luculentius cum Reformatis appa-reat, dicito non dissimulanter, sed candi-de, si potes; Cuias es tu, Lutheranus ne, an Calvinista, vel aliquod simile præter natu-ram in religione, cultuque diuino mon-strum? Sic enim dissidium hoc & consen-sus Græcorum obijcietur oculis. Alias cum inter eos confusa sint omnia, & unus alium impugnet, & injurijs lacessat, quid ipse sis, nondum exploratum est. Theologi Mans-feldenses, Suspectam habent Sacramenta-riorum doctrinam propter nouitatem : extitit nanque recens eorum tempore, & ignota fuit vetusta Ecclesia. Secundo quia Sacramentarij non definite in eadem sententia sunt concordes, sed in se ipsos diversi, ut inter eos sint Carlosta-diani, Zwingliani, Oecolampadiani, Swenck-feldiani, Campanista, Calviniani, & similes. Nicolaus Amsdorffius in publica confuta-tione purae doctrinae; Nos Zwinglianam_, & Osiandrinam Hærefim, & errores tranquilla conscientia amplecti non possumus: nec eorum_, qui se a Luthero segregarunt, successioni, aut novationi subscribere, & astipulari. Matthias Illyricus, in Defensione Confessionis Mar-tinistarum, Calvinistarum. Liturgia non uno sacrilegio vitiata est, contaminataque, eaque, proh dolor! innumeras animas æterno exitio in-voluit. Conradus Clusselbergius scripsit

page.notes: No marginal notes and no running head on this page. The thin strip at the right edge is the neighbouring page's edge and was left out. Small stains and a mark at the bottom left are not printed text. "Zwinglianam_," and "eorum_," end with a printed dash-like mark, kept as printed; the mark may be a continuation sign and is uncertain. The spellings "obijcietur" and "iniurijs" were kept with the printed i/j, and "iniurijs" was changed to "injurijs" by the consonant rule, which is uncertain.
